name.fr: KOF Centre de recherches conjoncturelles (EPF Zurich)
name.it: KOF Centro di ricerche congiunturali (PF Zurigo)

description.en: The KOF Economic Barometer, Switzerland's headline leading indicator for the business cycle, published monthly near month-end by the KOF Swiss Economic Institute at ETH Zurich. A composite of a large basket of predictors, designed to anticipate the year-on-year growth of Swiss GDP a few months ahead and normalised so the long-run mean sits near 100: above 100 signals above-average expected growth, below 100 the reverse.
